mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing between a shower and a tub upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: When deciding between a shower and a tub upgrade, consider your household's needs and future accessibility. Walk-in showers offer ease of access and can make a bathroom feel larger, while tubs are essential for households with young children or those who enjoy baths. Consider the long-term value and functionality for your lifestyle. We can discuss design options that maximize space and utility for either choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your household's needs, future accessibility, and long-term value when choosing between a shower and a tub. Walk-in showers offer accessibility, while tubs are good for families.
